name: Find or Create User
plugin_description: Integrates with Zendesk to manage support tickets from Kizen agentic workflows.
action_description: Looks up a Zendesk end user by Zendesk User ID, External ID, email, or name (in that priority order), optionally creating them if no match exists.

inputs.name: zendesk_user_id
inputs.label: Zendesk User ID
inputs.hint: Zendesk's own internal numeric user ID (not External ID — see that field for the distinction). Highest-priority search key — a direct, unambiguous record fetch, checked before External ID, Email, or Name.

inputs.name: external_id
inputs.label: External ID
inputs.hint: e.g. a Kizen contact ID, stored on the Zendesk user record for cross-referencing. Used to find an existing user (via Zendesk's guaranteed-unique external ID lookup) if Zendesk User ID isn't set, before Email or Name are considered. Also stored on the record when creating a new user.

inputs.name: user_email
inputs.label: Email
inputs.hint: Used to find an existing user if neither Zendesk User ID nor External ID is set, or create one if Create If Missing is enabled.

inputs.name: user_name
inputs.label: Name
inputs.hint: Lowest-priority search key — only used to find a user if none of Zendesk User ID, External ID, or Email is set. Required if Create If Missing is true and no user matches yet.

inputs.name: phone
inputs.label: Phone
inputs.hint: Only used when creating a new user.

inputs.name: organization_id
inputs.label: Organization ID
inputs.hint: Numeric Zendesk organization ID — visible in the organization's URL under Admin Center → People → Organizations. Only used when creating a new user.

inputs.name: create_if_missing
inputs.label: Create If Missing
inputs.hint: If true and no user matches Email, creates one. Defaults to false — no user is created otherwise.

outputs.name: was_created
outputs.label: Was Created
outputs.hint: True if a new user was created; false if an existing user was found.
